notes: This dataset contains supplementary material and data used for analysis. Supplemental Figure S1: 'Figure_S1.pdf' Supplemental Figure S2: 'Figure_S2.pdf' Supplemental Figure S3: 'Figure_S3.pdf' Supplemental Table S1: 'Table_S1.pdf' Data from Experiment 1 and 2: 'Experiment_1_data.csv' and 'Experiment_2_data.csv' Rows correspond to trials. Columns correspond to: - participant_id: Participant identifier. - uncertainty: Visual feedback uncertainty condition. 'CRS' for cursor (low uncertainty) and 'CLD' for cloud (high uncertainty). - target_direction: Target direction in degrees. - cycle_num: Cycle number. - hit: Whether trial was considered failed during data collection. 0 for failed and 1 for not failed. - condition: Visuomotor rotation block. 'base' for baseline, 'rot' for rotation and 'wash' for washout. - no_fb: Whether visual feedback was provided during reach. 0 for no-feedback and 1 for feedback. - hand_pksp_ang: Hand angle at peak speed of reach in degrees. - rt: Reaction time in ms. - mt: Movement time in ms.
